newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to auction railway concession July 18.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to auction railway concession July 18.

text.p: The National Development Bank (BNDES) has set a July 18 auction date and base price of 11.4 million reais ($10.7 million) for a 30-year concession to run the northeast section of Brazil's federal railway network.
Haroldo Prates, the BNDES's manager for privatization services, told Reuters on Monday that the bank planned to publish tender documents on May 2.

The concession involves the operation of the railway's 4,500-kilometer northeastern line, linking the northeastern state of Alagoas and northern Maranhao state. The line, used mainly to transport oil and derivatives, is the last part of the federal railway system to be privatized, Prates said.

In the last two years, the government has raised 1.5 billion reais by selling 30-year concessions to operate the western, central-eastern, southeastern, Tereza Cristina and southern sections of its network, Prates said.
